slides.0.title: Red varieties and the Cape Blend
slides.0.subtitle: Pinotage, Cinsault, Syrah, Cabernet
slides.1.title: Main red varieties
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Cabernet Sauvignon
slides.1.highlights.0.content: About 9.9% in 2025 (8,601 ha), the most planted red
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Syrah
slides.1.highlights.1.content: About 9.4% (8,103 ha), strong in warmer areas such as the Swartland
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Pinotage
slides.1.highlights.2.content: About 7.6% (6,619 ha), South Africa's own crossing
slides.1.highlights.3.title: Merlot
slides.1.content: The top four reds in 2025: Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Pinotage, Merlot.
slides.2.title: The story of Pinotage
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Parentage
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Pinot Noir × Cinsaut (then called Hermitage in South Africa), crossed by Professor Abraham Perold
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Dates
slides.2.highlights.1.content: The crossing dates from the mid-1920s (Perold's records give November 1924; 1925 is the usual date); first barrel in 1941; first on a label in 1961
slides.2.highlights.2.title: International recognition
slides.2.highlights.2.content: In 1991 Kanonkop Pinotage won the Robert Mondavi Trophy for Best Red Wine at the IWSC in London
slides.2.content: Sources differ between 1924 and 1925 for the crossing, so the year is not examined; the parentage Pinot Noir × Cinsaut is settled.
slides.3.title: The Cape Blend and other reds
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Cape Blend
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Usually a red blend that includes Pinotage, a distinctly South African style; producers and bodies define the minimum share differently, so no proportion is examined
slides.3.highlights.1.title: The Cinsault revival
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Old-vine Cinsault has regained attention in recent years, with a fresh, juicy style
slides.3.content: South African reds range from Bordeaux-style structure to light Cinsault.
Which two varieties were crossed to make Pinotage?
Perold's crossing; Cinsaut was then called Hermitage, hence the name.
Which red variety was the most planted in South Africa in 2025?
What did Kanonkop Pinotage win in London in 1991?
A. Decanter White Wine of the Year
B. Robert Mondavi Trophy for Best Red Wine
The Robert Mondavi Trophy at the IWSC.
